ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a reader's year
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: read {COUNT} different books from the colony's shelves

plain.li: There are books on our shelves I've never opened. I'm going to {GOAL}.
I used to read every night, before all this. I'd like to be a reader again.
[old] I've spent my life working. Now I'd like to read what other people thought about while I worked.

warm.li: Someone wrote every one of those books hoping it would be read. I'll do my part.

blunt.li: Going to read the books on the shelf. All of them, if I can.

cheerful.li: So many books, and I've only read the one about soil! Time to fix that.

gloomy.li: Books are the only way out of here I can think of. I'll take it.

cold.li: The shelves hold knowledge nobody is using. I'll {GOAL}.

plain.li: That's the last of them for this year. I feel as though I've been a long way and come home.
I've read every book I said I would. My head is full of other people's lives.

warm.li: I keep thinking about the people in those books, as if I'd met them.

cheerful.li: Done, and I already know which one I'm reading again first.

cold.li: The reading is done. I retained most of it.
